caption:
Lulu spends every shift chopping, plating and carrying trays. After service, the feet, back and wrists ache.

Standing in one spot on hard floors for hours can tire the legs and back. Shifting your weight, resting one foot on a low step and wearing supportive shoes can often help.

Hybi's 1-minute stretch: wrist stretch for 20 seconds, calf stretch for 20 seconds, 10 big shoulder rolls, every break. Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier, alongside regular movement.

Tingling fingers, wrist pain at night, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
